connector.name: LinkDeal
connector.registryDescription: Find B2B leads from LinkedIn engagement, enrich contacts and deliver to Slack.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.linkdeal.ai over server sent events. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.linkdeal.www. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token. Generate an API key at app.linkdeal.ai/settings. Keys start with ld_
